## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A single-*juan* Southern-Sòng commentary on Zhànrán's *Jīngāngbēi* ([KR6d0175](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0175), T1932) by **Bóting Shànyuè** 柏庭善月 of Sìmíng. Body attribution: *Sìmíng shāmén Shànyuè shù* 四明沙門　善月　述. Companion to Shànyuè's other Lotus-tradition productions ([KR6d0021](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0021), [KR6d0064](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0064)).

**Abstract**

Shànyuè's *Yìjiě* belongs to the substantial Southern-Sòng *shānjiā* commentarial tradition on Zhànrán's *Jīngāngbēi*, providing the orthodox *shānjiā* interpretation of the doctrine of the buddha-nature of insentient beings against the *shānwài* alternative interpretation preserved in Zhìyuán's *Xiǎnxìng lù* ([KR6d0179](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0179)).

The composition is bracketed within Shànyuè's productive period at the Yánqìngsì 延慶寺 in Sìmíng, c. 1180–1240.
